svg.text: The plot was unwatchable and utterly discombobulating.
our word tokenizer · 20,000 words, ranked by frequency in the training split
7 tokens, one of them empty of information.
Every rare word in the corpus meets the same fate.
WordPiece · 30,522 pieces, learned once on a corpus we never saw
13 pieces, none unknown. The three pieces of unwatchable keep the negation the word tokenizer threw away,
and an unseen word falls back to pieces, a piece to characters. The vocabulary cannot miss.
